title: Rodsher Lighthouse
visualBrief: Red octagonal tower with broad lower pedestal, reduced upper shaft, two opposed pairs of deep arched windows, flared masonry gallery, circular railed watch room, four solar panels on the authored+Z facade, wire-mesh lantern balcony, clear framed lantern, riveted domed roof, red ventilator and cardinal vane. Reviewed compass bearing is recorded separately in review-scope.json and map-frame.json.

sourceFacts.basis: The project supplies tower location and separate20m navigation-light height. Published survey mesh supplies relative body/lantern dimensions, including20.45m vane tip; its20.75m raw span includes rough ground. No surveyed north axis or EXIF compass was supplied. Solar-wall bearing270degrees true is a photo/context reconstruction with22.5degree uncertainty, not a precise engineering azimuth. OSM keeper-house polygons are contextual controls only, not a lighthouse footprint or part of this model. Clean survey-derived octagonal base is explicitly reconstructed geometry. Detached houses, natural granite shore, exact present paint decay and interior operation are omitted; footprint replacement stays off.

This component reconstruction has new geometry, metric UVs and shared procedural materials.

limitations: The modeled exterior follows the cited published facts and inspected photographs. Unpublished dimensions and local fittings are explicitly photo-proportioned; no claim of engineering survey accuracy is made.
Portable PBR and shared metric surfaces are provided. Surface weathering, material color under local lighting and fine facade relief require close render review before maximum-detail acceptance.

Published survey/photographic exterior is modeled using clean shared red plaster/iron rather than retaining baked photographic shadows. Thin gallery wire, glass panes and roof hardware are reconstructed as real geometry; surrounding detached derelict houses and island rock terrain remain map features. Small optical hardware is represented only to the detail visible through the lantern. Current maintenance color may vary, but the red daymark and structural arrangement follow the maritime-heritage project.
referenceRights: Original geometry and shared procedural materials. Official photographs are research references only; no reference imagery or third-party mesh is embedded or redistributed.
